876c9d5b98.en: A read of NeurIPS 2025 focused on one question: how do we make LLM-based software reliable? These papers push on self-verifying reasoning, faster knowledge-aware agents, and dynamic safety — the building blocks of AI you can actually depend on.
876c9d5b98.zh: NeurIPS 2025 解读，围绕一个问题：如何让基于大语言模型的软件可靠？这些论文推进了自验证推理、更快的知识感知智能体和动态安全 — 这是真正可依赖的 AI 的基础构件。

9bedddf318.en: {1}Also:{/1} Held across two cities (San Diego + Mexico City). Landmark NeurIPS papers include AlexNet, Dropout, DQN, Adam, the Transformer, and BERT.
9bedddf318.zh: {1}另外：{/1}在两座城市举办（圣迭戈 + 墨西哥城）。具有里程碑意义的 NeurIPS 论文包括 AlexNet、Dropout、DQN、Adam、Transformer 和 BERT。

ff9b714422.en: Dominant topics: diffusion & scientific generation, efficient LLM training/inference, reasoning / RAG / code / agents, preference alignment (RLHF, DPO), RL & uncertainty, and robustness / safety / interpretability.
ff9b714422.zh: 主要议题：扩散与科学生成、高效的大语言模型训练/推理、推理 / RAG / 代码 / 智能体、偏好对齐（RLHF、DPO）、强化学习与不确定性，以及鲁棒性 / 安全 / 可解释性。

19e95a9454.en: Teach a model to check its own reasoning during training, instead of relying on a separate verifier.
19e95a9454.zh: 让模型在训练期间检查自己的推理，而不是依赖单独的验证器。

bf68f5017f.en: LLMs reason fluently but can’t reliably tell when they are wrong; an external verifier adds cost, complexity and instability.
bf68f5017f.zh: 大语言模型 (LLM) 推理流畅，却无法可靠地判断自己何时出错；外部验证器会增加成本、复杂度和不稳定性。

7401d17329.en: Roll out chain-of-thought solutions to a batch of problems
7401d17329.zh: 对一批问题生成思维链解法

f322fd1c76.en: Turn each solution into a verification task via a template
f322fd1c76.zh: 通过模板把每个解法转成一个验证任务

84341b4a16.en: Jointly train reasoning and verification with RL (RISE)
84341b4a16.zh: 用强化学习 (RL) 联合训练推理与验证 (RISE)

93061f5f90.en: Goes past shallow ‘self-reflection’ — reasoning and checking are learned together in one RL loop.
93061f5f90.zh: 超越浅层的“自我反思”——推理与检查在同一个 RL 循环中一起学习。

a16ecf6a48.en: Models that audit their own answers — safer AI for code, education and decision support where wrong reasoning is costly.
a16ecf6a48.zh: 能审查自身答案的模型——为代码、教育和决策支持等错误推理代价高昂的场景提供更安全的 AI。

964a925400.en: RISE pipeline — generate solutions and their verifications, then jointly optimize both with RL.
964a925400.zh: RISE 流水线——生成解法及其验证，再用 RL 联合优化两者。

fe60e1651c.en: The two stages — solving, then self-verification reconstructed as verification tasks.
fe60e1651c.zh: 两个阶段——先求解，再把自我验证重构为验证任务。

c80416c9df.en: Rethinking Verification for LLM Code Generation (SAGA)
c80416c9df.zh: Rethinking Verification for LLM Code Generation (SAGA)

79d0abebbb.en: {1}Zihan Ma et al.{/1} · Shanghai AI Laboratory
79d0abebbb.zh: {1}Zihan Ma et al.{/1} · Shanghai AI Laboratory

14de58ba65.en: Judge an LLM’s code by the strength of the tests, not the size of the model.
14de58ba65.zh: 评判大语言模型的代码，应看测试的强度，而不是模型的大小。

b207833282.en: AI coding tools hide subtle logic bugs because existing test suites and verifiers miss edge cases.
b207833282.zh: AI 编程工具会隐藏细微的逻辑错误，因为现有的测试集和验证器遗漏了边界情况。

ea5bfec068.en: Define metrics for test-suite strength (detection rate, verifier accuracy)
ea5bfec068.zh: 定义测试集强度的指标（检出率、验证器准确率）

526f6a8be8.en: Generate stronger, more diverse tests with a human–LLM loop grounded on a trusted solution
526f6a8be8.zh: 通过以可信解法为基础的人机（人与大语言模型）循环，生成更强、更多样的测试

cd768a9511.en: Identifies test-suite strength — not model size — as the real limiter of reliable code generation.
cd768a9511.zh: 指出可靠代码生成的真正瓶颈是测试集强度，而不是模型大小。

a9b45bdb0a.en: Stronger QA pipelines, safer AI coding products, and standard metrics for benchmarking reliability.
a9b45bdb0a.zh: 更强的 QA 流水线、更安全的 AI 编程产品，以及用于基准测试可靠性的标准指标。

7daf261224.en: The SAGA human–LLM workflow for generating stronger, grounded test cases.
7daf261224.zh: SAGA 人机（人与大语言模型）工作流，用于生成更强的、有依据的测试用例。

ff75db1617.en: The code-evaluation pipeline and the different test-case-generation paradigms.
ff75db1617.zh: 代码评估流水线以及不同的测试用例生成范式。

2f8f9a5b3b.en: GAP: Graph-Based Agent Planning with Parallel Tools
2f8f9a5b3b.zh: GAP: Graph-Based Agent Planning with Parallel Tools

733e920123.en: Let a single agent run independent tool calls in parallel instead of one after another.
733e920123.zh: 让单个智能体并行执行相互独立的工具调用，而不是逐个依次执行。

93b3b472db.en: Sequential LLM agents are slow and costly on multi-step tasks; multi-agent setups add coordination overhead.
93b3b472db.zh: 顺序执行的大语言模型智能体在多步骤任务上又慢又贵；多智能体方案则带来协调开销。

0272f852fb.en: Build a dependency graph (DAG) of sub-tasks

a9b4f30ff3.en: Run independent branches in parallel; use RL to learn when to parallelize
a9b4f30ff3.zh: 并行运行相互独立的分支；用 RL 学习何时并行

59e8747b67.en: Parallelism without the complexity of multi-agent systems — one agent that learns task dependencies.
59e8747b67.zh: 获得并行能力，又没有多智能体系统的复杂性——一个能学习任务依赖关系的智能体。

0c394ac11b.en: Lower latency, fewer tokens and cheaper tool-augmented workflows — good for real-world deployment.
0c394ac11b.zh: 更低的延迟、更少的 token，以及更便宜的工具增强工作流——适合实际部署。

f7c8a14bb3.en: The GAP paradigm — tasks are decomposed into a dependency graph so independent tool calls run in parallel.
f7c8a14bb3.zh: GAP 范式——任务被分解为依赖图，使相互独立的工具调用得以并行运行。

22b378de86.zh: 顺序执行与基于图的（并行）智能体执行对比。

99b48e89a3.en: Keep graph foundation models up to date without retraining them.
99b48e89a3.zh: 无需重新训练，就让图基础模型保持最新。

0644a0f149.en: Graph models are expensive to retrain and hallucinate structure as the underlying graph data changes.
0644a0f149.zh: 图模型重新训练成本高，而且随着底层图数据变化会对结构产生幻觉。

b2043a0056.en: Build a multi-level graph index (node, edge, graph features)
b2043a0056.zh: 构建多层级图索引（节点、边、图特征）

117005c930.en: Retrieve the most relevant subgraphs per task type
117005c930.zh: 按任务类型检索最相关的子图

6e1fbf68d8.en: Fuse them with the query graph by features and topology
6e1fbf68d8.zh: 按特征和拓扑将它们与查询图融合

f7ada0f9bb.en: Injects fresh knowledge at inference with structure-aware retrieval — O(log N) lookup instead of retraining.
f7ada0f9bb.zh: 在推理时通过结构感知检索注入最新知识——O(log N) 的查找，代替重新训练。

a358b63f3b.en: Adaptive, low-cost, always-updated graph intelligence for fraud detection, recommendations and dynamic knowledge.
a358b63f3b.zh: 面向欺诈检测、推荐和动态知识的自适应、低成本、始终保持更新的图智能。

87412592f1.en: Conventional training-driven GFMs vs RAG4GFM — retrieve and fuse external graph knowledge at inference instead of retraining.
87412592f1.zh: 传统的训练驱动 GFM 与 RAG4GFM 对比——在推理时检索并融合外部图知识，而不是重新训练。

393249efa7.en: {1}Shiyuan Yin et al.{/1} · Henan University of Technology
393249efa7.zh: {1}Shiyuan Yin et al.{/1} · Henan University of Technology

a6214c1aca.en: Give LLM-driven robots a trustworthy sense of when a plan is risky.
a6214c1aca.zh: 让由大语言模型驱动的机器人可靠地感知计划何时有风险。

ba840cf973.en: Robots can’t safely decide whether to act or ask when their uncertainty signals are unreliable.
ba840cf973.zh: 当不确定性信号不可靠时，机器人无法安全地决定是直接行动还是先询问。

8fdbf84031.en: Split uncertainty into epistemic (knowledge gaps) and intrinsic (randomness)
8fdbf84031.zh: 把不确定性拆分为认知不确定性（知识缺口）和内在不确定性（随机性）

02513728ec.en: Gauge familiarity with RND novelty detection; combine into one risk score
02513728ec.zh: 用 RND 新颖性检测衡量熟悉度；合并为一个风险分数

7ebd9f88f0.en: Separates uncertainty into clarity, familiarity and unpredictability — a structured, planner-agnostic layer.
7ebd9f88f0.zh: 把不确定性拆分为清晰度、熟悉度和不可预测性——一个结构化的、与规划器无关的层。

9bed610376.en: A plug-and-play safety layer so robots act or ask appropriately — more dependable home and factory automation.
9bed610376.zh: 即插即用的安全层，让机器人恰当地选择行动或询问——使家庭和工厂自动化更可靠。

143a171ea0.en: Overview of CURE — the combined uncertainty-estimation framework for reliable planning.
143a171ea0.zh: CURE 概览——用于可靠规划的组合式不确定性估计框架。

eefb784a5a.en: Uncertainty is split into epistemic (task clarity, familiarity) and intrinsic components.
eefb784a5a.zh: 不确定性被拆分为认知（任务清晰度、熟悉度）和内在两部分。

5359316314.en: The components combine into a single risk score that decides whether to act or ask.
5359316314.zh: 各部分合并为一个风险分数，由它决定是行动还是询问。

a5d08c99a5.en: Safe + Safe = Unsafe? Jailbreaking VLMs with Safe Images
a5d08c99a5.zh: Safe + Safe = Unsafe? Jailbreaking VLMs with Safe Images

d96c334ff2.en: {1}Chenhang Cui et al.{/1} · National University of Singapore
d96c334ff2.zh: {1}Chenhang Cui et al.{/1} · National University of Singapore

7afae907b8.en: Show that even safe images can be chained together to jailbreak vision-language models.
7afae907b8.zh: 证明即使是安全的图像，串联起来也能越狱视觉语言模型。

d67d22ded0.en: Safety work focuses on obviously harmful inputs; benign images are a blind spot.
d67d22ded0.zh: 安全工作集中在明显有害的输入上；良性图像是一个盲区。

74df3bbdf0.en: Pair safe images with gentle questions
74df3bbdf0.zh: 把安全图像与温和的问题配对

8f214eb28c.en: Escalate over multiple turns and watch for unsafe reasoning
8f214eb28c.zh: 在多轮对话中逐步升级，并留意不安全的推理

62c82db2e2.en: Measure how often models ‘snowball’ and analyze why
62c82db2e2.zh: 衡量模型出现“滚雪球”现象的频率，并分析原因

56453f5212.en: A realistic black-box attack using only safe images — exposing risks from the model’s own reasoning.
56453f5212.zh: 一种只使用安全图像的现实黑盒攻击——暴露出模型自身推理带来的风险。

0bdb33321d.en: Calls for cross-modal consistency checks, multi-turn self-evaluation and safe-input red-teaming benchmarks.
0bdb33321d.zh: 呼吁进行跨模态一致性检查、多轮自我评估，以及针对安全输入的红队测试基准测试。

e9d7523e2f.en: The Safety Snowball Agent (SSA) framework — a two-stage agent that probes VLM safety.
e9d7523e2f.zh: Safety Snowball Agent (SSA) 框架——一个用于探测 VLM 安全性的两阶段智能体。

00f1b567cd.en: DRIFT: Dynamic Defense for Securing LLM Agents
00f1b567cd.zh: DRIFT: Dynamic Defense for Securing LLM Agents

d6d60af594.en: Defend LLM agents against prompt injection without crippling their usefulness.
d6d60af594.zh: 保护大语言模型智能体免受提示词注入，同时不削弱其可用性。

a6dc9c39a4.en: Static defenses are inflexible and fail on new attacks; model-level safeguards miss unseen injections.
a6dc9c39a4.zh: 静态防御缺乏灵活性，无法应对新攻击；模型层面的保护措施也挡不住未见过的注入。

7c643eb22b.en: Secure Planner builds a minimal action plan + parameter checklist
7c643eb22b.zh: Secure Planner 构建最小化的行动计划和参数清单

eaf0e2686e.en: Dynamic Validator flags deviations; Injection Isolator masks malicious instructions
eaf0e2686e.zh: Dynamic Validator 标记偏离；Injection Isolator 屏蔽恶意指令

c2fd3cdfc5.en: Enforces control- and data-level rules dynamically, adapting policies in real time.
c2fd3cdfc5.zh: 动态执行控制层和数据层规则，并实时调整策略。

d01cb05ea5.en: Safer, flexible agent deployments — beats fixed-rule systems (e.g. CaMeL) on adaptability vs. protection.
d01cb05ea5.zh: 更安全、更灵活的智能体部署——在适应性与保护之间的权衡上优于固定规则系统（如 CaMeL）。

7a5ab7f38f.en: DRIFT overview — a two-stage dynamic defense (Secure Planner, Dynamic Validator, Injection Isolator).
7a5ab7f38f.zh: DRIFT 概览——两阶段动态防御（Secure Planner、Dynamic Validator、Injection Isolator）。

5b0248db8a.en: Model-level vs system-level defense — DRIFT combines control- and data-level rules.
5b0248db8a.zh: 模型层面防御与系统层面防御对比——DRIFT 结合了控制层和数据层规则。

2ea2897c32.en: Reliability, verification and interpretability are now first-class goals, not afterthoughts.
2ea2897c32.zh: 可靠性、验证和可解释性如今已是首要目标，而不是事后补充。

a8b113de56.en: Agents are getting structured — dependency graphs, retrieval and self-checking replace brute force.
a8b113de56.zh: 智能体正变得结构化——依赖图、检索和自我检查取代了蛮力。

130a0c91f9.en: Safety must be cross-modal and dynamic; even ‘safe’ inputs and new injections are threats.
130a0c91f9.zh: 安全必须是跨模态且动态的；即使是“安全”的输入和新型注入也是威胁。

b39eb28497.en: AI that reasons more deliberately and checks its own work.
b39eb28497.zh: 推理更审慎、并会检查自身工作的 AI。

d1db8df88d.en: Compute- and energy-efficient architectures for sustainable training and serving.
d1db8df88d.zh: 兼顾算力与能效的架构，支持可持续的训练与服务。

9dabac4dce.en: Standard metrics and benchmarks for trust, not just accuracy.
9dabac4dce.zh: 面向可信度（而不只是准确率）的标准指标和基准测试。

24c60fee25.en: Invest in self-verifying reasoning and stronger test / verification pipelines.
24c60fee25.zh: 投入自我验证推理，以及更强的测试与验证流水线。

bdcee1b2c4.en: Adopt parallel, retrieval-augmented agents to cut latency and cost.
bdcee1b2c4.zh: 采用并行的、检索增强的智能体，以降低延迟和成本。

94e4d8f73e.en: Add adaptive, cross-modal safety and injection defenses to agent products.
94e4d8f73e.zh: 为智能体产品加入自适应的跨模态安全与注入防御。

98057a2978.zh: 第 39 届神经信息处理系统大会 · 美国圣迭戈和墨西哥墨西哥城 · 2025 年 12 月 2–7 日

688460a961.en:
Insights

  • Reliability, verification and interpretability are now first-class goals, not afterthoughts.
  • Agents are getting structured — dependency graphs, retrieval and self-checking replace brute force.
  • Safety must be cross-modal and dynamic; even ‘safe’ inputs and new injections are threats.

Vision

  • AI that reasons more deliberately and checks its own work.
  • Compute- and energy-efficient architectures for sustainable training and serving.
  • Standard metrics and benchmarks for trust, not just accuracy.

Implications for us

  • Invest in self-verifying reasoning and stronger test / verification pipelines.
  • Adopt parallel, retrieval-augmented agents to cut latency and cost.
  • Add adaptive, cross-modal safety and injection defenses to agent products.
688460a961.zh:
洞察

  • 可靠性、验证和可解释性如今已是首要目标，而不是事后补充。
  • 智能体正变得结构化——依赖图、检索和自我检查取代了蛮力。
  • 安全必须是跨模态且动态的；即使是“安全”的输入和新型注入也是威胁。

愿景

  • 推理更审慎、并会检查自身工作的 AI。
  • 兼顾算力与能效的架构，支持可持续的训练与服务。
  • 面向可信度（而不只是准确率）的标准指标和基准测试。

对我们的启示

  • 投入自我验证推理，以及更强的测试与验证流水线。
  • 采用并行的、检索增强的智能体，以降低延迟和成本。
  • 为智能体产品加入自适应的跨模态安全与注入防御。
